sources.role: Parameterized electrical link/router models; separate dynamic activity and technology-dependent non-data-dependent power.
sources.transfer_limit: No DSENT process library or physical router mapping has been fitted to this aggregate machine. Do not import a fixed router pJ or link pJ/mm from another design.

sources.unit: normalized energy per access/operation in the authors' commercial 65nm example
sources.role: Shows the need to count hierarchy-specific accesses and local reuse, not just byte-distance.
sources.transfer_limit: CNN 16-bit dataflow and 65nm storage/network differ from FP8 weight/FP32 accumulation, aggregate 192MiB SRAM and stacked RWDL. These ratios are contextual anchors, not coefficients or empirical ranges for W2W.

sources.role: Command-level energy requires a command trace, memory specification, state durations and signal activity.
sources.transfer_limit: Full application captures have read atoms and row statistics, not audited ACT/PRE/REF traces or SeDRAM currents. Command mode rejects missing evidence; per-read-bit mode is conditional and leaves a DRAM state/command residual.

sources.role: Physical pitch and interconnect scaling affect bandwidth density and energy per bit.
sources.transfer_limit: Pitch is not a calibrated payload-energy coefficient. This machine has no measured pad/driver/CDC/clock toggles; HB pJ/bit remains an explicit parameter.

sensitivity_policy.link_and_router: Independent nonnegative coefficients over the complete simplex of reference modeled-energy shares; exact linear inequality, not a chosen favorite pJ/bit value.
sensitivity_policy.bounded_ranges: edp_range accepts explicit finite coefficient, common-power and residual bounds. Every parameter is required. Bounds are declared scenarios unless accompanied by matching process/macro calibration.
sensitivity_policy.residual: Report allowable unmeasured candidate energy using Tc*R_candidate - Tr*R_reference. An unconstrained residual prevents unconditional total EDP or PPA claims.
sensitivity_policy.double_counting: noc_data_bit_mm is diagnostic only. Charge sideband-inclusive cell distance once. Command-array energy replaces the per-read-bit array term; it is never added on top of that term.
